correctness.rationale: Exact choose-unmatched-sets enumeration gives the Gibbs deficit weights; a rejection-coupling with the Bessel coefficients bounds TV by half of the second factorial moment over n. A generalized Laguerre polynomial with positive simple roots makes the finite deficit Poisson-binomial, yielding strict within-shore negative covariance by Cauchy-Schwarz and cross-shore positivity by conditional variance. Explicit factorial moments give the three coefficients; their strict signs follow from covariance with a decreasing reciprocal. Exact weight ratios prove the saturation window. A standalone independent recursive checker passed 728 supplementary exact/numerical assertions.

value.rationale: Near-perfect matchings and remaining unmatched vertices are natural saturation observables in lattice gases. The theorem identifies the exact n-scale activity window, a nontrivial order-one Bessel defect law with a rigorous explicit TV rate, strict opposite pairwise spatial signs at every finite activity, and all three rescaled covariance coefficients. This connects spectral root structure to physically meaningful joint monomer fluctuations, rather than an arbitrary table or elementary parameter substitution.
